env.buildPhase:
runHook preBuild
work=$TMPDIR/work/a/b/c/d/project
mkdir -p $work
cp -r /nix/store/j4s4fahcx6m1h3lx54s6dhhbs5f91hdh-kl9hsvf184175v9wm96k3rj72qa404fm-source/. $work

chmod -R u+w $TMPDIR/work

cd $work
export HOME=$TMPDIR
# nixpkgs' Python setup hook puts the site-packages of each Python
# package among the build inputs on PYTHONPATH, which would come ahead
# of the locked packages in pip and in `python -m build`.
unset PYTHONPATH

/nix/store/0cg6jdihhgnddmf0al0n2c9ml5mkjh53-python3-3.14.8-env/bin/python3.14 /nix/store/viaz6pnnim87xs97n4cxbwp1g32csc0x-source/offline.py tag . 8.1.8
/nix/store/0cg6jdihhgnddmf0al0n2c9ml5mkjh53-python3-3.14.8-env/bin/python3.14 -m pip wheel --no-deps --wheel-dir $out .
/nix/store/0cg6jdihhgnddmf0al0n2c9ml5mkjh53-python3-3.14.8-env/bin/python3.14 -m build --sdist --outdir $out .
/nix/store/0cg6jdihhgnddmf0al0n2c9ml5mkjh53-python3-3.14.8-env/bin/python3.14 /nix/store/viaz6pnnim87xs97n4cxbwp1g32csc0x-source/offline.py normalize-sdist $out/click-8.1.8.tar.gz
for f in click-8.1.8-py3-none-any.whl click-8.1.8.tar.gz; do
  if [ ! -e "$out/$f" ]; then
    echo "pip-purifier: the build made $(ls $out), not $f. Run \`pip-purifier lock\`." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
runHook postBuild
env.name: click-8.1.8-dist

env.buildCommand:
export HOME=$TMPDIR
cp -r /nix/store/j4s4fahcx6m1h3lx54s6dhhbs5f91hdh-kl9hsvf184175v9wm96k3rj72qa404fm-source project
chmod -R u+w project
cd project
mkdir legacy-inputs
if pip-purifier prefetch --inputs "$PWD/legacy-inputs" --venv legacy-env >legacy.log 2>&1; then
  echo 'legacy inputs without their target interpreter were accepted' >&2
  exit 1
fi
grep -q 'offline inputs have no target Python' legacy.log

pip-purifier prefetch --inputs /nix/store/4x7hcnfmqx6whhha47cp9m0rim5lqpmr-pip-purifier-inputs
export PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH"
python - <<'PYTHON'
import socket
try:
    socket.create_connection(('1.1.1.1', 443), timeout=5)
except OSError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('external network is reachable: sandbox required')
PYTHON
pytest -q tests
mkdir -p $out
cp pip-purifier.lock.json $out/
python - <<'PYTHON' > $out/runtime.json
import importlib.metadata as m, json, platform, sys
print(json.dumps({'python': sys.version, 'executable': sys.executable,
                  'platform': platform.platform(),
                  'distributions': sorted((d.metadata['Name'], d.version) for d in m.distributions())}, indent=2))
PYTHON
env.name: pip-purifier-ordinary-development
